pages.text: A Gem Cutter's Table is a crafting station used to refine Raw Radiant Quartz into Shaped Radiant Quartz. Items that require finesse to craft are generally made on a Gem Cutter's Table.$(br2)Unlike conventional crafting, there are no shape requirements for a Gem Cutter's Table recipe. After selecting the desired item you can simply remove it from the output slot if enough ingredients are present.

The internal inventory of a Gem Cutter's Table can be filled by a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/brazierhoarding)Brazier of Hoarding$(/l). Slots with existing items will be filled, but new items will never be added to empty slots.$(br2)Gem Cutter's Tables can be crafted conventionally.
